mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 900.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it indicates a slowdown in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based consumer spending contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL annual change above 2.5% signals a monetary policy response to inflation that increases real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is above 7.5% and declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in industrial production signals a worsening supply shock that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95.0 and declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.
